title: Mula shopping list hanggang receiving.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Ito ang DAC’S WorkMate para sa Procurement Staff at Buying. Sa preview na ito, sundan natin ang flow mula assigned items hanggang purchase at receiving.
spokenText: Ito ang Daks WorkMate para sa Procurement Staff at Buying. Sa preview na ito, sundan natin ang flow mula assigned items hanggang purchase at receiving.
direction: Logo → buying workspace. Title: “Mula shopping list hanggang receiving.”

title: Alam kung ano ang uunahin.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa buying list, makikita ang project, quantity, urgency, at importanteng changes. Puwedeng ayusin ang view by batch o project para malinaw ang uunahin.
spokenText: Sa buying list, makikita ang project, quantity, urgency, at importanteng changes. Puwedeng ayusin ang view by batch o project para malinaw ang uunahin.
direction: Shopping list; batch/project filters; urgency and changed-quantity badges.

title: Klaro kung sino ang bibili.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: May items na assigned sa iyo. Para sa available na portion, puwede mong piliin ang I’ll buy this habang online. Makikita ng ibang authorized buyers kung sino ang may hawak.
spokenText: May items na assigned sa iyo. Para sa available na portion, puwede mong piliin ang I’ll buy this habang online. Makikita ng ibang authorized buyers kung sino ang may hawak.
direction: Assigned portion; I’ll buy this on unassigned portion; named buyer.

title: I-record ang actual na binili.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa pagbili, i-record ang actual item, specification, quantity, supplier, at purchase date. Ilakip ang receipt at kumpletuhin ang purchase details para malinaw ang record.
spokenText: Sa pagbili, i-record ang actual item, specification, quantity, supplier, at purchase date. Ilakip ang receipt at kumpletuhin ang purchase details para malinaw ang record.
direction: Record actual item/spec/unit, supplier/date, receipt; values masked.

title: Bought six. Four to go.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Halimbawa, sampu ang kailangan at anim ang nabili. Bought: six. Still to buy: four. Sa iyo pa rin ang natitirang assignment, maliban kung i-release mo ito.
spokenText: Halimbawa, sampu ang kailangan at anim ang nabili. Bought: six. Still to buy: four. Sa iyo pa rin ang natitirang assignment, maliban kung i-release mo ito.
direction: Needed 10 → Bought 6 → Still to buy 4; release remaining portion.

title: Isang receipt. Tamang allocation.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Isang receipt, maraming project items? I-attach ito nang isang beses, tapos itugma ang bawat line sa tamang project at work scope, o sa warehouse destination.
spokenText: Isang receipt, maraming project items? I-attach ito nang isang beses, tapos itugma ang bawat line sa tamang project at work scope, o sa warehouse destination.
direction: One receipt, two project lines; Main Contract/AW/warehouse destinations.

title: May pagbabago? May dahilan.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Kung may substitute, panatilihing visible ang original request at ilagay ang dahilan ng replacement. May unplanned purchase? Kailangan din ng reason at tamang destination.
spokenText: Kung may substitute, panatilihing visible ang original request at ilagay ang dahilan ng replacement. May unplanned purchase? Kailangan din ng reason at tamang destination.
direction: Original and substitute side by side; required reason; unplanned purchase.

title: Purchase at payment. Hiwalay.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Hiwalay ang pagbili sa pagbabayad. Puwedeng Unpaid muna ang purchase. Kapag bayad na, idagdag ang payment details sa parehong record, nang walang panibagong material expense.
spokenText: Hiwalay ang pagbili sa pagbabayad. Puwedeng Unpaid muna ang purchase. Kapag bayad na, idagdag ang payment details sa parehong record, nang walang panibagong material expense.
direction: Unpaid → payment details → Paid; same purchase ID persists.

title: Bilangin. I-check. I-confirm.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Hiwalay din ang delivery. Para sa direct-to-site receiving, i-confirm habang online ang actual quantity, location, at condition. Receipt photo lang ay hindi pa proof na available ang stock.
spokenText: Hiwalay din ang delivery. Para sa direct-to-site receiving, i-confirm habang online ang actual quantity, location, at condition. Receipt photo lang ay hindi pa proof na available ang stock.
direction: Awaiting delivery → explicit received qty/location/condition → usable stock.

title: Draft muna. Sync kapag online.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: Walang signal sa supplier? I-save muna ang supported purchase details at photos bilang draft. Pending sync pa ito. Sa reconnect, iche-check ang changes bago ma-update ang shared records.
spokenText: Walang signal sa supplier? I-save muna ang supported purchase details at photos bilang draft. Pending sync pa ito. Sa reconnect, iche-check ang changes bago ma-update ang shared records.
direction: Offline purchase draft/photo → Pending sync → assignment conflict.

title: Kita ang materials, bawat location.
label: PLANNED MODULE
narration: Sa planned inventory workflow, malinaw ang warehouse at site quantities, kasama ang reservations, receipts, issues, transfers, at returns. Ang confirmed na usable quantity lang ang magiging available.
spokenText: Sa planned inventory workflow, malinaw ang warehouse at site quantities, kasama ang reservations, receipts, issues, transfers, at returns. Ang confirmed na usable quantity lang ang magiging available.
direction: Planned warehouse/site balances, reservations, partial receiving, returns.

title: Mas malinaw ang bawat bili.
label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA
narration: DAC’S WorkMate for Buying. Klaro kung sino ang bibili, ano ang nabili, ano pa ang kulang, at ano ang natanggap.
spokenText: Daks WorkMate for Buying. Klaro kung sino ang bibili, ano ang nabili, ano pa ang kulang, at ano ang natanggap.
direction: Request → buyer → receipt → receiving recap and logo.
